caption: The drawing features a single object resembling a weather vane against a plain, off-white background. The vane consists of a horizontal arrow element that has a pointed tip on the right and a tail with three chevron-shaped notches on the left; both the tip and the tail are colored in a light tan hue with subtle shading for depth. At the center where the horizontal arrow meets the vertical axis, there is a small circular orb atop a triangular lattice, colored in a muted brown, which provides structural support. The vertical axis is a pale wooden rod with three ring-like sections spaced evenly along its length, giving it a segmented appearance. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by beige, tan, and brown tones, with fine line work outlining each component. The object is isolated in the center of the composition with no additional items or background detail present.
title: Weather Vane
